tc_townhall.gui.suggestion_box.title: Suggestion Box
tc_townhall.gui.suggestion_box.hint: Unhappy citizens drop a short note here each morning.
tc_townhall.gui.suggestion_box.empty: No notes yet. Citizens who have something on their mind write one in the morning.
tc_townhall.gui.ballot_box.title: Election in %s
tc_townhall.gui.ballot_box.no_colony: Place the ballot box inside your colony
tc_townhall.gui.ballot_box.platform: What will you do for the colony?
tc_townhall.gui.ballot_box.fill_in: Write a slogan and what you will do first.
tc_townhall.gui.ballot_box.not_member: Only members of this colony can stand for its mayor.
tc_townhall.gui.ballot_box.how: Standing calls an election. Citizens hear your slogan and plans and pass them on; with voice chat you then have 30 seconds for a speech. A citizen may stand against you. Then every grown citizen votes.
tc_townhall.gui.ballot_box.campaigning: Talk to your citizens until voting starts: they vote on what they heard and how they feel about you. You can update your platform or speak again.
tc_townhall.gui.ballot_box.join: An election is running. You can still stand until voting begins.
tc_townhall.gui.ballot_box.no_promises: No promises of the mayor are known yet.
tc_townhall.gui.ballot_box.no_proposal: The mayor has no proposal for you right now.
